value.rationale: The motivated design gap is that monotone fractional diffusion and a conservative explicit CFL do not control high-frequency relative spectral accuracy. The exact logarithmic phases show both over- and under-damping on the same physical mesh family, with computable nonvanishing error constants, identifying the need to refine log-sinc spacing separately from extending its cutoff. This is a natural operator benchmark, not an arbitrary table value.
